# B2 vocabulary batch 102

Added 25 manually authored B2 entries: `multiply`, `mumble`, `muse`, `mustache`, `mutability`,
`mutable`, `mutter`, `mutton`, `mystify`, `nano`, `narcissistic`, `narrator`, `naval`, `needless`,
`negatively`, `neighboring`, `neighbouring`, `nerves`, `nervously`, `netsurfer`, `neurosis`,
`newscaster`, `newsworthy`, `nicely`, and `nightclub`.

The translation for `mustache` was kept neutral so it did not introduce a Vietnamese proper-name
token. All rows were then manually checked for meaning, part of speech, IPA, level, controlled
topics, and original example pairs.
